2021.title: Predictive Text Input for Virtual Reality
2021.short_description: A complete predictive text input solution for xrdesktop. It is an aggregation of three input modes: Dasher, Swype and a normal virtual keyboard....
2021.description: A complete predictive text input solution for xrdesktop. It is an aggregation of three input modes: Dasher, Swype and a normal virtual keyboard. Combined, they form a VR input system that is highly effective for experienced users, but also usable for first-time users.

2021.title: glTF virtual environment loading
2021.short_description: Virtual desktops look nice with a comfortable environment round them. This project allows the user to use a glTF file as their custom xrdesktop...
2021.description: Virtual desktops look nice with a comfortable environment round them. This project allows the user to use a glTF file as their custom xrdesktop environment and adds more features to the gulkan library to add support for better-looking scenes.
